verdicts.why: In Marvel Zombies episode 1 Ikaris is only fighting the zombie Captain Marvel when Kamala's group runs into the battle. He never joins or travels with them, and Wikipedia calls him a 'survivor' only in the sense of uninfected. The Survivors stage has no on-screen basis.

T:pr-st-pride is the shared PRIDE group file. It is deliberately linked as the twin of all eight Pride member records (Catherine and Geoffrey Wilder, Leslie Dean, Janet and Victor Stein, the Yorkes, Tina and Robert Minoru), so it is not one character merged into Robert's record. Unlinking Robert alone would make him inconsistent with the other seven; whether group files should be twins at all is a structural call for the owner.

In Thunderbolts* Alexei owns and drives for Red Guardian Limo Service (shown on his limo, slogan 'Protecting you from boring evening'), and that is how he overhears Valentina's plot. He then teams up with the Thunderbolts, so the stage belongs between Independent and The Thunderbolts.

Curt Connors is the lead scientist of the ESU Labs throughout The Spectacular Spider-Man. In S2E13 he leaves ESU and New York with his family for the Florida Everglades to escape Warren's blackmail. This matches the twin A:sv-curt-connors-ssm.

Comanche joins Mariah's Stokes crew as Ridenhour's undercover informant, and undercover service counts as membership. In S2E7 he kills Ridenhour, insists he would never betray the family, and Shades shoots him. He dies without ever quitting or being thrown out, so the Independent stage and the left title have no move behind them.

The film names the Fairmont on screen ('Hello, sir. Welcome to the Fairmont...'). Shang-Chi works there as a valet with Katy and tells Katy's mother they both like their job at the Fairmont, before the bus attack sends him to Macau and Ta Lo.

In Daredevil S1 Vanessa works as an art dealer at Scene Contempo Gallery, named on screen (Karen: 'It says she works at Scene Contempo Gallery'), where Fisk buys Rabbit in a Snowstorm in episode 3. Her next stage, Fisk's Empire in S3, is the move out of it.

In Morbius, Michael works at Horizon Labs: the building appears in the film's New York, Marvel Database lists Horizon Labs in the film, and Looper calls it the place where Morbius treats patients and keeps his lab. He never quits; ending the film a fugitive is not a departure. Medium confidence: no source quotes an exact on-screen line or sign.
This is the same person in the same film as A:sv-michael-morbius, so the same Horizon Labs employment applies with no departure, and the twin records stay consistent.

In The Punisher S2 episode 6 'Nakazat', Poloznev names the Schultzes' company on screen ('Testament Industries. Factories, oil and chemicals, and farming...'). Anderson and Eliza founded and own it, and they never leave it before they die.

Owlsley's employer is named on screen. In Daredevil S1E7 he says 'I work for Silver & Brent', and in E10 Marci says 'Owlsley at Silver & Brent'. In E13 he ends his partnership with Fisk, which is a real move out of Fisk's Empire, while E13 still has him using Silver & Brent company funds. He therefore falls back to his firm rather than to no group.

In Madame Web Cassie works as an FDNY paramedic with Ben Parker and O'Neil; Marvel Database lists her affiliation as the New York City Fire Department, and the dataset already uses 'FDNY'. Nothing on screen has her quit.

AWOL is an LAPD officer for the whole run, and in episode 19 he becomes head of the same LAPD strike team that PRIDE pays; the wiki lists LAPD as his only affiliation. His LAPD and PRIDE memberships run at the same time, and dropping the last LAPD stage would say he left the LAPD, which never happens on screen either. In an unsure case the record stays as it is.
